purpose: Hash-bound model/delta proposal contract applied only by deterministic runtime.

shape.base_state_sha256: sha256 hex of canonical pre-patch state
shape.dependency_fingerprint: optional on first pass; required by policy for repeat-pass optimization
shape.allowed_roots: non-empty list of top-level state roots the node contract permits
shape.set: object keyed by JSON Pointer-like absolute paths
shape.delete: optional list of paths; forbidden unless allow_delete=true and node contract permits deletion
